title: Sliding Window Median
statement:
Given an array of integers and a window size K, output the median of each sliding window of size K.

For odd K, the median is the middle element. For even K, the median is the average of the two middle elements — print as X.5 if it is not a whole number.

There are N-K+1 windows.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N-K+1 space-separated values: the median of each window.
